sentences.text:
======================================================
 Jai Prakash Kumar Arya Son Of Baidhnath Ram Resident

OF VILLAGE - MOTIHARI, P.S. - TOWN MOTIHARI, DISTRICT - EAST  CHAMPARAN  ... ..
 Versus  THE STATE OF BIHAR  ... ... Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Prateek Tandon, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Ajay Mishra, A.P.P.
 ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE PRABHAT KUMAR SINGH  ORAL ORDER 2 19-10-2023 Heard the parties.

2. Petitioner apprehends arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 467,
468, 471, 420 of the Indian Penal Code.
3. The petitioner is alleged to have attempted to obtain appointment, as Panchayat Teacher, on the basis of forged and fabricated document(s).
4. It is submitted on behalf of petitioner that petitioner was never actually appointed on the post of Panchayat Teacher.
5. Learned A.P.P. for the State vehemently opposes the prayer for anticipatory bail.

6. Considering the facts that petitioner was never Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.67414 of 2023(2)
dt.19-10-2023 appointed on the post of Panchayat Teacher, this anticipatory bail is allowed and it is ordered that let the above named petitioner in the event of his arrest/surrender before the court below within a period of six weeks from today, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail-bond of Rs.
